To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we are developing a system that is able to integrate different levels of knowledge, and to simulate the effects of a protein in neurodegeneration.
we developed a new approach that integrates the text mining and dynamical simulation to support the virtual investigation of neurodegenerative disease.

1) a new approach to the study of complex diseases has been proposed, based on the integration of different data sources, and on the development of a computational system able to process the data in order to extract the knowledge required for the dynamism model; 2) this approach has been applied to the study of neurodegenerative disease, and the results obtained are promising.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of a knowledge discovery approach for the design of a virtual system that can be used for the study of the dynamical behaviour involved in neurodegeneration.

the application of a computational tool for the integration of heterogeneous data sources in a virtual environment, in order to support the development of mathematical models of complex biological systems.
the development and implementation, of a knowledge discovery and system biology program for the virtual analysis of pathways involved in neurogenerative diseases.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the system is a good example of how to integrate the different approaches in a complex problem.

this work is an important step in the development of a new generation of computational tools for the investigation of the molecular mechanisms of the neurodegenerative disease, and it is the first step towards a complete virtual analysis of the molecular mechanisms underlying the pathogenesis of these diseases.
the system is able to integrate multiple data sources and to extract a knowledge representation that can be used to support the design of dynamical models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the knowledge discovery is a fundamental step for the development of a dynamical model.
the system is able to process heterogeneous data sources, to extract the relevant knowledge, and to simulate the biological system in terms of mathematical model.
the system has been able to identify the main molecular actors in the CDK5 pathway and to simulate the dynamics of the system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a system based on a combination of ML and dynamical model can be a useful tool to support the development of new therapeutic strategies for the treatment of neurodegenerative disease.
a multidisciplinary approach is required to study the complex biological systems.
the integration of the different data sources is essential for a correct model development; the knowledge discovery is the key point of the process.
